text:
Situation: Celecoxib 200 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 441 capsules (33.5 days on hand at 13.2 used per day). Corvale General holds 524 capsules (27.1 days on hand at 19.3 used per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows celecoxib is not listed as of 2026-10-21. A label for celecoxib names Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC (FEI 3017450153) as a repack plant that received a VAI classification on 2024-09-06.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately one month of supply at both sites. Multiple manufacturers not on FDA's shortage list are available for purchase.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Actavis Pharma, Inc. as the primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify AiPing Pharmaceutical, Inc. as a secondary source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. as a tertiary source; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to monitor daily usage and inventory levels at both sites; requires buyer approval.
5. Buyer to report any supply changes to the Pharmacy and Therapeutics committee at the next scheduled meeting; requires committee acknowledgment.

Not recommended: No clinical formulary changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
